Description: Ensure that RDS instances have SSL enabled to encrypt data in transit.
Risk: Without SSL, data transmitted between the application and the database is sent in plaintext, making it vulnerable to interception and man-in-the-middle attacks.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Relational Database Service.
3. Select the instance.
4. Click the Parameters tab.
5. Set require_ssl to ON.
6. Click Save.

Recommendation.Text: Enable SSL for all RDS instances to encrypt data in transit.
